epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Dispatch held: the environment cannot do the measurement. ⛔ Not a claim.

- Measured at 2026-11-01T12:03Z from this seat's container: a POST to `https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/` (an MCP `initialize`, no token) answered `curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`. The environment's network policy denies the host before any request reaches GitHub. With a token, the call would still be refused there.
- This environment also has no dedicated measurement secret. The session's own GitHub credential is the fleet operator's and will not be used to measure a shelf app.
- Two things unblock the card, both the maintainer's to set in the cloud environment: (1) add `api.githubcopilot.com` to the environment's allowed network domains; (2) store a read-only GitHub token whose scopes list both `search_issues` and `issue_read`, as the environment secret `GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN` (the app's own `credentialRef`). Once both are in place, the epic seat claims and dispatches this card. No placeholder digests will be committed.

epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Parked: `pm:blocked` on #30116 · 2026-11-04T14:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

- The maintainer ordered the measurement to move off-cloud, verbatim 「立一张维护者处理卡，让维护者在本机测试」 (2026-11-04, in this seat's session). #30116 carries that step (`pm:awaiting-maintainer`). The maintainer runs a no-dependency Node script on their own machine with their own read-only token, and posts its JSON: both digests plus the two public tool definitions.
- `Blocked-by: #30116` is added to the body. When #30116 closes, the epic seat claims and dispatches this card. The dev takes the digests from #30116's comment, recomputes them offline with `computeMcpToolsSnapshot` over the posted `tools`, and commits them only if the two agree. The posted definitions become an offline test fixture. The cloud environment no longer needs `api.githubcopilot.com` or `GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN` for this card.

## Triage: unblocked and released to the lane · `pm:blocked` + `pm:epic` → `pm:queue` · 2026-11-08T16:21Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- **Latest state comment, read first:** the epic seat's park on #30116 (2026-11-04T14:58Z). There is no hold after it.
- **#30116 is done** (both digests posted 2026-11-06T17:27Z) and is closed as completed.
- **The epic seat signed off** (2026-11-05T14:09Z) with no successor. Under #31502 A′ point 2, the orphaned epic's children move to the lane queues now. This card is single-package and standalone (`connector-github` ships two pinned digests), so it carries no concentration risk; the maintainer's 「可以归车道，并且单独开发没风险的，都放回车道」 covers it.
- **For the claiming dev:**
  - The digests were measured with a broader-than-read-only token.
  - Ship them as measured, and record the scope in the changeset or the PR body.
  - If the read-only scope should serve a different tool set, the drift check that consumes `toolsSnapshot` will say so on first use. That is a follow-up, not a blocker.
- `domain:server`, p2.
